name: rationale
description: Why this stands as it does — the reasoning that would otherwise be lost.

aiGuidance.purpose: The reasoning behind a position: what was weighed, what was rejected, and what would have to change for the position to change. This is the part that stops a later reader re-opening a settled question, so it is written for someone who was not in the room.
aiGuidance.extraction: Capture the forces, not just the conclusion — name the alternative that was considered and say why it lost. Where the source records a trigger for revisiting ("if federation returns..."), keep it verbatim.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not restate the conclusion as its own justification ("we chose X because X is right"). If no reasoning is recoverable from the source, leave the field empty rather than inventing one.
